payload.title: File:Howesia browni (SAM-PK-K10180, mandible).jpg
payload.artist_html: S. N. F. Spiekman, C. Browning, M. Tshibalanganda, D. Mukherjee, R. M. H. Smith, A. Du Plessis & F. Wolvaardt
payload.credit_html: "Micro-CT informed cranial anatomy of the early rhynchosaur Howesia browni, with implications for rhynchosaur skull evolution"
payload.description_html: μCT-derived reconstruction of the mandible of Howesia browni SAM-PK-K10180. A, left hemimandible in lateral view. B, left hemimandible in dorsal view. C, right hemimandible in medial view. D, associated skull with mandible in anterior view. Bones are labelled; other relevant morphological structures are marked in bold and underlined. Abbreviations: adf, adductor fossa; an, angular; ar, articular; co, coronoid; cop, coronoid process; de, dentary; glf, glenoid fossa; l., left; mep, medial process; Mkg, Meckelian groove; mnp, mentonian process; pra, prearticular process; r., right; rap, retroarticular process; sa, surangular; sas, surangular shelf; spl, splenial; vmp, ventromedial process. Scale bars represent: 20 mm (A–C); 10 mm (D).
